article.story: Oklahoma (4-4) at No. 25 Florida (5-3), Nov. 7 at 7:45 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Florida by 6.5. Against the spread: Florida 4-4, Oklahoma 3-5. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Florida Offense Overall: 426 yards per game (35th in FBS) Passing: 249.3 yards per game (41st) Rushing: 176.8 yards per game (42nd) Scoring: 35.6 points per game (23rd) Florida Defense Overall: 368.5 yards per game (77th in FBS) Passing: 235.8 yards per game (104th) Rushing: 132.8 yards per game (55th) Scoring: 28.1 points per game (103rd) Oklahoma Offense Overall: 336.9 yards per game (111th in FBS) Passing: 230.1 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 106.8 yards per game (128th) Scoring: 22 points per game (108th) Oklahoma Defense Overall: 304.6 yards per game (20th in FBS) Passing: 175.4 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 129.3 yards per game (51st) Scoring: 20.8 points per game (38th) Oklahoma ranks 7th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 28.2% of third downs. Florida ranks 127th in the FBS averaging 75 penalty yards per game, compared to Oklahoma's 73rd-ranked 57 per-game average. Oklahoma ranks 124th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Florida is 19th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:30. Team leaders Florida Passing: Aaron Philo, 1,367 yards, 9 TDs, 5 INTs, 70.5 completion percentage Rushing: Jadan Baugh, 801 yards on 152 carries, 13 TDs Receiving: Dallas Wilson, 417 yards on 31 catches, 3 TDs Oklahoma Passing: John Mateer, 1,835 yards, 13 TDs, 7 INTs, 65.6 completion percentage Rushing: Lloyd Avant, 347 yards on 79 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Sategna III, 591 yards on 45 catches, 3 TDs Last game Florida fell to Georgia 27-8 on Oct. 31. Tramell Jones Jr. led Florida with 172 yards on 18-of-25 passing (72.0%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball nine times for 17 yards and one rushing touchdown. Baugh had 38 rushing yards on 17 carries. Bailey Stockton recorded 76 yards on eight catches. Oklahoma fell 42-25 to South Carolina on Oct. 31. Mateer threw for 244 yards on 26-of-43 attempts (60.5%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 11 times for 29 yards. Tory Blaylock had 32 rushing yards on six carries. Ivan Carreon had five receptions for 88 yards and two touchdowns. Next game Florida plays at No. 8 Kentucky on Nov. 14. Oklahoma hosts No. 12 Ole Miss on Nov. 14.
